natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both declining, and two prior durable findings indicate that simplifying onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation for self-serve/SMB accounts. This directly addresses current weaknesses while avoiding the established retention risk of broad promotional pricing. Verify both records before finalizing scope and success thresholds.
